title: EverBloom
description: Experience a re-imagined Minecraft with EverBloom, a modpack designed to enrich your Minecraft world with new biomes, structures, quality-of-life features and breathtaking visuals.
body:
# <center> 🌸 EverBloom - Re-Imagined Minecraft 🌸 </center>
**EverBloom** is a Vanilla+ Minecraft modpack focused on reworking the world generation, adding to survival mechanics, improving structures and building, and adding quaility-of-life updates to Minecraft.

If you're looking for a **vanilla-friendly** modpack that improves Minecraft and not a modpack that adds 500+ mods to completely change Minecraft, and make it a entirely different game. Then **EverBloom** is for you!

---

[![Chat with us on Discord](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-plural_vector.svg)](https://discord.com/invite/R8SNsAKnes) [![curseforge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/curseforge_vector.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/everbloom)

- 
### ✨ Features
- 🌍 Complete overhauled world generation ([OTBW'G](https://modrinth.com/mod/NTi7d3Xc) & [WWOO](https://modrinth.com/mod/II7t6llZ))
- 🧟 Slight mobs spawning reworked ([Stray](https://modrinth.com/mod/2lg2mCPe), [Husk](https://modrinth.com/mod/pfNveXQV), [Cave Spider](https://modrinth.com/mod/9IUlkb2K), [Naturally Charged Creepers Spawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/j5LquiGA) & more)
- 🐝 Reworked mobs ([Realistic Bees](https://modrinth.com/mod/tG6HkcWx), [Mooshroom Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/B10lMHiA), [Despawning Eggs Hatch](https://modrinth.com/mod/iKRtwScn), [Grabby Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/O6Sh7btX) & more)
- 🏰 Old and New Structures ([DNT ACO](https://modrinth.com/mod/DNuNq5bb), [DNT POR](https://modrinth.com/mod/QIt10I7z), [DNT SR](https://modrinth.com/mod/rYocd2LE), & [T&T](https://modrinth.com/mod/DjLobEOy))
- 🛖 Villages and Villagers given names ([Random Village Names](https://modrinth.com/mod/N0ytbukx), & [Villager Names](https://modrinth.com/mod/gqRXDo8B))
- 🚀 New items to collect ([Artifacts](https://modrinth.com/mod/P0Mu4wcQ))
- 🎣 Fishing expanded ([Tide 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/die1AF7i))
- 🧱 Make any block a stair, slap, door, etc ([FramedBlocks](https://modrinth.com/mod/wbgfS34j))
- 🏡 Decorate your home or building with new furniture and blocks ([Re:Deco](https://modrinth.com/mod/xejiztgi), & [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/BAscRYKm))
- 💧 Remember to stay hydrated ([Thirst Was Taken](https://modrinth.com/mod/iUheEnjm))
- ✨ A handful of Visual reworks ([Visuality: Reforged](https://modrinth.com/mod/z13R7Et1), [Tooltip Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/vRFcG5n6), & [Particular](https://modrinth.com/mod/pYFUU6cq))
- 🧰 A handful of quality-of-life features ([TrashSlot](https://modrinth.com/mod/vRYk0bv7), [Stone Zoon](https://modrinth.com/mod/uYwn8IP5), [Every Compat](https://modrinth.com/mod/eiktJyw1), [Starter kit](https://modrinth.com/mod/6L3ydNi8), & more)
- ✨ Renewed visuals ([Reimagined GUI (Dark)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reimaginedguidark), [Slyme's Boxy Font](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/boxy-font), [Cubic Sun & Moon](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cubic-sun-moon), & [Mellow Shader](https://modrinth.com/shader/mellow))

| Name | Concept | Modpack Version |
| ----------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| EverBloom 1.2 | A simple update that will optimize the pack for better performance and start the workflow for more updates | 1.2.x |
| Life Finds a Way | New animals and monsters, with possible new bosses | 1.3.x |
| Dimensional Rework | The plan for this update is to finally rework the end/nether dimensions. Possibly adding new dimensions to explore | 1.4.x |
